title: Shield of the Americas Update — Aug 31, 2026
summary: Backfilled and corrected the record on Washington's May 2026 terrorist designation of Brazil's PCC and Comando Vermelho gangs, replacing a vague, undated, single-sourced timeline entry with an officially sourced account: the State Department designated both groups Specially Designated Global Terrorists / Foreign Terrorist Organizations on 28 May over Lula's objections, after Trump-aligned candidate Flávio Bolsonaro lobbied for the move. New reporting shows Bolsonaro met El Salvador's justice minister in São Paulo on 30 August and pledged to declare cartels terrorist groups domestically if elected in October, aligning his campaign with the coalition's hardline framing even as Brazil remains a holdout state. Timeline, claims, political figures and the Brazil map point were updated; the tracker's breaking flag was cleared as the acute CIA-covert-program story from late August has not produced new developments since.

title: Shield of the Americas Update — Aug 29, 2026
summary: New York Times and Washington Post reporting alleges an unacknowledged CIA covert boat-attack program, distinct from Southern Spear/JTF-WHEM, struck three Ecuadorian fishing vessels in January-March 2026 — the Fiorella, Negra Francisca Duarte II and Don Maca — killing or disappearing at least eight people, with survivors describing torture by English-speaking operatives traced via flight-tracking data to El Salvador's Ilopango airport. The Ecuadorian prosecutor investigating the attacks was assassinated in June 2026. Separately, JTF-WHEM boarded and sank a Treasury-sanctioned narco 'refueling station' vessel on 28 August in a non-lethal interdiction with Ecuador. Timeline, KPIs, claims and map points were updated to reflect the covert-program allegation alongside the existing Southern Spear campaign.

title: Shield of the Americas Tracker Update — Aug 28, 2026
summary: Joint Task Force Western Hemisphere carried out a second lethal strike in three days, killing 4 people aboard a suspected go-fast drug-smuggling vessel in the Caribbean Sea on 25 August — the campaign's confirmed toll now stands at 227+ killed across 68 strikes since September 2025. Gen. Francis Donovan said JTF-WHEM would continue to 'hunt, disrupt, and defeat' narco-terrorist networks. The strike lands amid intensifying oversight scrutiny: Sen. Tim Kaine has called victims of some strikes 'murder victims' based on a classified-intelligence review, and the Pentagon Inspector General's targeting-procedure review continues. KPIs and the legality-of-strikes claim were updated to reflect the new toll and the deepening congressional pushback.

title: Shield of the Americas Tracker Update — Aug 25, 2026
summary: The newly stood-up Joint Task Force Western Hemisphere carried out its first lethal strike on 23 August, killing 2 people aboard a suspected 'narco-sub' in the eastern Pacific and ending a roughly two-month pause in boat strikes since 21 June. The campaign's confirmed toll now stands above 67 vessels destroyed and 200+ killed since September 2025. The strike drew fresh scrutiny: Sen. Tim Kaine says classified intelligence shows strikes have likely killed people uninvolved in trafficking, and the Pentagon Inspector General is reviewing whether standard targeting procedures were followed. KPIs and the contested-claims matrix were updated to reflect the resumed campaign and the new oversight scrutiny.
